"""Excel-style price sheets using the shared planning-grid controller."""

from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from reflex.vars import ObjectVar

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.excel_grid import (
    excel_grid,
    grid_cell_attrs,
    grid_row_attrs,
)
from alloq_commons.components.toolbar import icon_button, primary_button
from alloq_commons.models.price_list import PriceGridRow
from alloq_commons.state.price_list_state import PriceListState as S

COLUMNS = [
    ("la", "LA", "", 64),
    ("label", "Rolle", "", 220),
    ("hourly_cost", "Stundensatz", "HK", 120),
    ("daily_cost", "Tagessatz", "HK", 120),
    ("minimum_daily", "Tagessatz", "inkl. DB · Mindest-VK", 140),
    ("minimum_hourly", "Stundensatz", "Mindest-VK", 120),
    ("sales_price", "Tagessatz", "VK", 120),
    ("hourly_sales", "Stundensatz", "VK", 120),
]
COLUMN_WIDTHS = {column: width for column, _, _, width in COLUMNS}
ROLE_COLUMN_WIDTH = 190
ACTION_COLUMN_WIDTH = 84
CELL_STYLE = {
    "border": "1px solid var(--alloq-border)",
    "height": "28px",
    "padding": "2px 6px",
    "fontVariantNumeric": "tabular-nums",
    "whiteSpace": "nowrap",
    "position": "relative",
    "userSelect": "none",
}
SHEET_CSS = """
#price-list-grid th, #price-comparison-grid th {
  background-color: var(--alloq-surface-muted);
  text-align: right;
  padding: 6px;
}
#price-list-grid th:nth-child(-n+2),
#price-comparison-grid th:nth-child(-n+2) { text-align: left; }
#price-list-grid td, #price-comparison-grid td {
  padding: 2px 6px;
  height: 28px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
#price-list-grid td .mantine-Select-input {
  height: 22px;
  min-height: 22px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  padding-top: 0;
  padding-bottom: 0;
}
#price-list-grid td[data-calculated="false"],
#price-comparison-grid td[data-calculated="false"] {
  background: var(--alloq-surface-solid);
}
#price-list-grid td[data-calculated="true"],
#price-comparison-grid td[data-calculated="true"] {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mantine-color-blue-6) 6%,
    var(--alloq-surface-solid));
}
"""


def _visible(column: str, component: rx.Component) -> rx.Component:
    if column == "hourly_cost":
        return rx.cond(S.hourly_visible, component, rx.fragment())
    return component


def _sticky(column: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if column in {"la", "label"}:
        return {
            "position": "sticky",
            "left": "0px" if column == "la" else f"{COLUMN_WIDTHS['la']}px",
            "zIndex": 3,
            "boxShadow": "inset -1px 0 0 var(--alloq-border)",
        }
    return {}


def _cell(
    row: ObjectVar[PriceGridRow], column: str, width: int, comparison: bool
) -> rx.Component:
    text = column in {"la", "label"}
    editable: Any = text or column == "sales_price"
    if column in {"hourly_cost", "daily_cost"}:
        basis = S.compare_cost_basis if comparison else S.cost_basis
        editable = basis == ("hour" if column == "hourly_cost" else "day")
    calculated = rx.cond(editable, "false", "true")
    if comparison:
        editable = False
    attrs = grid_cell_attrs(
        row.key.to(str) + "|" + column,
        column,
        row.cell_values.to(dict[str, str])[column],
    )
    attrs.update(
        {
            "data-cell-type": "text" if text else "decimal",
            "data-read-only": rx.cond(editable, "false", "true"),
            "data-calculated": calculated,
            "data-max-length": 50 if column == "la" else 255,
            "aria-readonly": rx.cond(editable, "false", "true"),
        }
    )
    if column in {"la", "label"}:
        attrs["data-grid-frozen"] = "true"
    warning = row.below_minimum if column == "sales_price" else False
    if column == "sales_price":
        attrs["data-copy-value"] = row.effective_sales
    attrs["data-below-minimum"] = rx.cond(warning, "true", "false")
    return _visible(
        column,
        mn.table.td(
            row.display.to(dict[str, str])[column],
            p="2px 6px",
            ta="left" if text else "right",
            custom_attrs=attrs,
            title=rx.cond(
                warning,
                "Angebots-VK liegt unter dem Mindest-VK",
                rx.cond(
                    editable,
                    "Eingabe · Doppelklick oder direkt tippen",
                    "Berechnet · schreibgeschützt",
                ),
            ),
            style={
                **CELL_STYLE,
                **_sticky(column),
                "minWidth": f"{width}px",
                "width": f"{width}px",
                "maxWidth": f"{width}px",
                "textAlign": "left" if text else "right",
                "overflow": "hidden",
                "textOverflow": "ellipsis",
                "backgroundColor": "var(--alloq-surface-solid)",
                "color": rx.cond(
                    warning, "var(--mantine-color-yellow-light-color)", theme.TEXT
                ),
            },
        ),
    )


def _row(row: ObjectVar[PriceGridRow], comparison: bool = False) -> rx.Component:
    cells = [_cell(row, column, width, comparison) for column, _, _, width in COLUMNS]
    if not comparison:
        cells.extend(
            [
                rx.cond(
                    S.show_roles,
                    mn.table.td(
                        mn.select(
                            data=S.role_options.to(list),
                            value=row.role_id,
                            clearable=True,
                            placeholder="Keine Verknüpfung",
                            size="xs",
                            w="100%",
                            on_change=lambda value: S.set_role(row.key, value),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                            disabled=S.is_saving,
                        )
                    ),
                    rx.fragment(),
                ),
                mn.table.td(
                    mn.group(
                        mn.action_icon(
                            rx.icon("arrow-up", size=14),
                            title="Zeile nach oben",
                            variant="subtle",
                            size="xs",
                            aria_label="Zeile nach oben",
                            on_click=S.move_row(row.key, -1),
                        ),
                        mn.action_icon(
                            rx.icon("arrow-down", size=14),
                            title="Zeile nach unten",
                            variant="subtle",
                            size="xs",
                            aria_label="Zeile nach unten",
                            on_click=S.move_row(row.key, 1),
                        ),
                        mn.action_icon(
                            rx.icon("trash-2", size=14),
                            title="Zeile löschen",
                            variant="subtle",
                            size="xs",
                            aria_label="Zeile löschen",
                            color="red",
                            on_click=S.delete_row(row.key),
                        ),
                        gap=0,
                        wrap="nowrap",
                    ),
                    p="4px",
                    style={"whiteSpace": "nowrap"},
                ),
            ]
        )
    return mn.table.tr(
        *cells, key=row.key, custom_attrs=grid_row_attrs(row.key, "rates")
    )


def price_sheet(comparison: bool = False) -> rx.Component:
    columns = [
        _visible(column, rx.el.col(style={"width": f"{width}px"}))
        for column, _, _, width in COLUMNS
    ]
    base_width = sum(
        width for column, _, _, width in COLUMNS if column != "hourly_cost"
    )
    table_width = rx.Var.create(base_width) + rx.cond(
        S.hourly_visible, COLUMN_WIDTHS["hourly_cost"], 0
    ).to(int)
    headers = []
    for column, title, subtitle, width in COLUMNS:
        headers.append(
            _visible(
                column,
                mn.table.th(
                    mn.text(title, fw="600", size="sm"),
                    mn.text(subtitle or "\u00a0", fw="500", size="xs"),
                    bg=theme.SURFACE_MUTED,
                    ta="left" if column in {"la", "label"} else "right",
                    style={
                        **CELL_STYLE,
                        **_sticky(column),
                        "minWidth": f"{width}px",
                        "width": f"{width}px",
                        "backgroundColor": "var(--alloq-surface-muted)",
                        "zIndex": 6 if column in {"la", "label"} else 5,
                        "textAlign": "left" if column in {"la", "label"} else "right",
                    },
                ),
            )
        )
    if not comparison:
        columns.extend(
            [
                rx.cond(
                    S.show_roles,
                    rx.el.col(style={"width": f"{ROLE_COLUMN_WIDTH}px"}),
                    rx.fragment(),
                ),
                rx.el.col(style={"width": f"{ACTION_COLUMN_WIDTH}px"}),
            ]
        )
        table_width += ACTION_COLUMN_WIDTH + rx.cond(
            S.show_roles, ROLE_COLUMN_WIDTH, 0
        ).to(int)
        headers.extend(
            [
                rx.cond(S.show_roles, mn.table.th("Planungsrolle"), rx.fragment()),
                mn.table.th("", style={"width": f"{ACTION_COLUMN_WIDTH}px"}),
            ]
        )
    table = mn.table(
        rx.el.colgroup(*columns),
        mn.table.thead(
            mn.table.tr(*headers), custom_attrs={"data-grid-header": "true"}
        ),
        mn.table.tbody(
            rx.foreach(
                S.compare_rows if comparison else S.rows,
                lambda row: _row(row, comparison),
            )
        ),
        sticky_header=True,
        with_column_borders=True,
        with_table_border=True,
        horizontal_spacing="xs",
        vertical_spacing="xs",
        style={
            "borderCollapse": "separate",
            "borderSpacing": 0,
            "tableLayout": "fixed",
            "width": table_width.to_string() + "px",
            "minWidth": table_width.to_string() + "px",
            "maxWidth": table_width.to_string() + "px",
        },
    )
    return excel_grid(

COLUMNS = [

]

ROLE_COLUMN_WIDTH = 190
ACTION_COLUMN_WIDTH = 84
CELL_STYLE = {
    "border": "1px solid var(--alloq-border)",

    "userSelect": "none",
}
SHEET_CSS = """

  background-color: var(--alloq-surface-muted);
  text-align: right;
  padding: 6px;
}
#price-list-grid th:nth-child(-n+2),
#price-comparison-grid th:nth-child(-n+2) { text-align: left; }
#price-list-grid td, #price-comparison-grid td {

def _visible(column: str, component: rx.Component) -> rx.Component:
    if column == "hourly_cost":
        return rx.cond(S.hourly_visible, component, rx.fragment())
    return component


def _sticky(column: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if column in {"la", "label"}:
        return {
            "position": "sticky",
            "left": "0px" if column == "la" else f"{COLUMN_WIDTHS['la']}px",
            "zIndex": 3,
            "boxShadow": "inset -1px 0 0 var(--alloq-border)",
        }
    return {}


def _cell(
    row: ObjectVar[PriceGridRow], column: str, width: int, comparison: bool
) -> rx.Component:
    text = column in {"la", "label"}
    editable: Any = text or column == "sales_price"
    if column in {"hourly_cost", "daily_cost"}:
        basis = S.compare_cost_basis if comparison else S.cost_basis
        editable = basis == ("hour" if column == "hourly_cost" else "day")
    calculated = rx.cond(editable, "false", "true")
    if comparison:
        editable = False
    attrs = grid_cell_attrs(
        row.key.to(str) + "|" + column,
        column,
        row.cell_values.to(dict[str, str])[column],
    )
    attrs.update(
        {
            "data-cell-type": "text" if text else "decimal",
            "data-read-only": rx.cond(editable, "false", "true"),
            "data-calculated": calculated,
            "data-max-length": 50 if column == "la" else 255,
            "aria-readonly": rx.cond(editable, "false", "true"),
        }
    )
    if column in {"la", "label"}:
        attrs["data-grid-frozen"] = "true"
    warning = row.below_minimum if column == "sales_price" else False
    if column == "sales_price":
        attrs["data-copy-value"] = row.effective_sales
    attrs["data-below-minimum"] = rx.cond(warning, "true", "false")
    return _visible(
        column,
        mn.table.td(
            row.display.to(dict[str, str])[column],
            p="2px 6px",
            ta="left" if text else "right",
            custom_attrs=attrs,
            title=rx.cond(
                warning,
                "Angebots-VK liegt unter dem Mindest-VK",
                rx.cond(
                    editable,
                    "Eingabe · Doppelklick oder direkt tippen",
                    "Berechnet · schreibgeschützt",
                ),
            ),
            style={
                **CELL_STYLE,
                **_sticky(column),
                "minWidth": f"{width}px",
                "width": f"{width}px",
                "maxWidth": f"{width}px",
                "textAlign": "left" if text else "right",
                "overflow": "hidden",
                "textOverflow": "ellipsis",
                "backgroundColor": "var(--alloq-surface-solid)",
                "color": rx.cond(
                    warning, "var(--mantine-color-yellow-light-color)", theme.TEXT
                ),
            },
        ),
    )

                    ),
                    rx.fragment(),
                ),
                mn.table.td(
                    mn.group(
                        mn.action_icon(

                            title="Zeile nach oben",
                            variant="subtle",
                            size="xs",
                            aria_label="Zeile nach oben",
                            on_click=S.move_row(row.key, -1),
                        ),
                        mn.action_icon(

                    p="4px",

def price_sheet(comparison: bool = False) -> rx.Component:
    columns = [

"""Access levels of the alloq roles.

Roles add up, and only roles grant access: the admin switch opens just the
administration (``@requires_admin``). The employee role reads projects and
planning; the project manager role edits them and opens dashboard and team, so
a project manager needs the employee role on top. Every signed-in user may
read the offers; only the offer editor role may change them.
"""

import inspect
import logging
from collections.abc import Callable
from functools import wraps
from typing import Any, Final

import reflex as rx

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_commons.roles import EMPLOYEE_ROLE, OFFER_EDITOR_ROLE, PROJECT_MANAGER_ROLE
from appkit_commons.roles import Role
from appkit_user.authentication.backend.models import User
from appkit_user.authentication.components.components import requires_role
from appkit_user.authentication.states import LoginState, UserSession

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_NOT_AUTHORIZED_MSG: Final = "Sie haben keine Berechtigung für diese Aktion."

ACCESS_LEVEL_ATTR: Final = "alloq_access_level"
"""Attribute naming the guard (``viewer``/``editor``) of a decorated handler."""

CAN_EDIT: Final = UserSession.user.roles.contains(PROJECT_MANAGER_ROLE.name)
"""Frontend Var: the signed-in user may edit the planning pages."""


def has_role(user: User, role: Role) -> bool:
    """Whether ``user`` holds ``role``; the admin switch does not count."""
    return role.name in user.roles


NO_ACCESS_MSG: Final = (
    "Sie haben nicht die notwendigen Berechtigungen, um auf diese Seite zuzugreifen."
)


def no_access() -> rx.Component:
    """Page content for signed-in users without read access."""
    return mn.center(
        mn.stack(
            mn.text(NO_ACCESS_MSG, fz="15px", fw=500),
            rx.link("Zu den Angeboten", href="/offers"),
            align="center",
            gap=8,
        ),
        h="60vh",
        px=24,
    )


def viewer_only(*children: Any, fallback: rx.Component | None = None) -> rx.Component:
    """Render ``children`` for the employee role (reading)."""
    return requires_role(*children, role=EMPLOYEE_ROLE.name, fallback=fallback)


def editor_only(*children: Any, fallback: rx.Component | None = None) -> rx.Component:
    """Render ``children`` for the project manager role (edit controls)."""
    return requires_role(*children, role=PROJECT_MANAGER_ROLE.name, fallback=fallback)


def _guard[F: Callable[..., Any]](func: F, role: Role, level: str) -> F:
    """Wrap event handler ``func`` so only users holding ``role`` run it.

    Mirrors appkit's ``requires_admin``: unauthenticated callers are redirected
    to login, everyone else without the right gets a permission error.
    """

    async def _check(self: Any) -> tuple[bool, Any]:
        """``(allowed, event)``; ``event`` answers a denied call."""
        login_state = await self.get_state(LoginState)
        user = await login_state.authenticated_user
        if user is None:
            logger.debug("User not authenticated, redirecting to login.")
            return False, await login_state.redir()
        if not has_role(user, role):
            logger.warning(
                "User user_id=%s denied %s action '%s'",
                user.user_id,
                level,
                func.__name__,
            )
            return False, rx.toast.error(_NOT_AUTHORIZED_MSG, position="top-right")
        return True, None

    @wraps(func)
    async def async_gen_wrapper(self: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        ok, event = await _check(self)
        if not ok:
            yield event
            return
        async for item in func(self, *args, **kwargs):
            yield item

    @wraps(func)
    async def async_wrapper(self: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        ok, event = await _check(self)
        if not ok:
            return event
        return await func(self, *args, **kwargs)

    wrapper = async_gen_wrapper if inspect.isasyncgenfunction(func) else async_wrapper
    setattr(wrapper, ACCESS_LEVEL_ATTR, level)
    return wrapper  # type: ignore[return-value]


def requires_viewer[F: Callable[..., Any]](func: F) -> F:
    """Allow a read-only event for the employee role."""
    return _guard(func, EMPLOYEE_ROLE, "viewer")


def requires_editor[F: Callable[..., Any]](func: F) -> F:
    """Allow a reading or writing event for the project manager role."""
    return _guard(func, PROJECT_MANAGER_ROLE, "editor")


def requires_offer_editor[F: Callable[..., Any]](func: F) -> F:
    """Allow an offer event for the offer editor role."""
    return _guard(func, OFFER_EDITOR_ROLE, "offer_editor")

"""The price sheet exposes typed cells and the existing Excel controller."""

import json
from collections.abc import Iterator

import pytest
import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons.components.price_list import (
    price_list_editor,
    price_list_toolbar,
    price_sheet,
)


def _walk(component: rx.Component) -> Iterator[rx.Component]:
    yield component
    for child in component.children:
        yield from _walk(child)


def test_document_navigation_is_in_the_header() -> None:
    header = " ".join(str(control) for control in price_list_toolbar())
    for marker in (
        "list_options",
        "request_action",
        "duplicate",
        "new",
        "toggle_archive",
        "save",
        "discard",
    ):
        assert marker in header
    assert "aq-icon-btn" in header
    assert "request_action" not in str(price_list_editor())


def test_template_controls_are_removed() -> None:
    rendered = str(price_list_editor()) + " ".join(
        str(control) for control in price_list_toolbar()
    )
    assert "template_key" not in rendered
    assert "set_template" not in rendered


@pytest.mark.parametrize("comparison", [False, True])
def test_frozen_headers_stay_above_scrolling_headers(comparison: bool) -> None:
    headers = [
        node
        for node in _walk(price_sheet(comparison=comparison))
        if node.tag == "Table.Th" and "zIndex" in node.style

On this page

Roles, rates, departments and holidays ​

This page covers the master data that an administrator keeps for the whole organisation. The planning uses the roles and the public holidays, the team uses the departments, and the daily rates page turns production cost into sales prices. The stories belong to the activity "Set up the organisation" on the story map. The other half of that activity is on the page Users and access.

The activity has these user tasks and sub-tasks on this page:

  • Maintain master data. Maintain roles, maintain departments, and maintain public holidays.
  • Set daily rates. Enter production cost, set the contribution margins, and set a manual list price.

All four pages are for administrators only. Each page factory passes admin_only=True and wraps its content in requires_admin, and every event handler that reads or writes the database has the @requires_admin decorator. The security page explains the access levels.

The departments slice is the worked example on the layers page, so this page does not explain the layers again. The data model lists the fields of each entity.

ADM-03 Create roles ​

Create the roles (skills) that employees and project staffing use.

As an administrator, I want to keep a list of roles, so that employees can be given roles and projects can ask for them.

Administrator · Maintain master data / Maintain roles · priority 1 · core · v0.2.0 · skeleton

Acceptance criteria ​

  1. Given a signed-in admin, when the admin opens /admin/roles ("Rollen" [roles]), then the table lists all roles ordered by name with the columns "Name", "Beschreibung" [description], "Ramp-Up" and "Ramp-Down". The loading row "Lade Rollen..." [loading roles] only shows on the first load, and later visits refresh the rows in place.
  2. Given the dialog "Rolle hinzufügen" [add role], opened with the button "Neue Rolle" [new role], when the admin enters the data, then "Name" is required and at most 255 characters, "Abkürzung" [abbreviation] is at most 3 characters, and "Beschreibung" is optional. The switches "Ramp-Up" and "Ramp-Down" mark a role that a project needs during its ramp-up or ramp-down.
  3. Given a name made of spaces only, when the admin saves, then the handler trims the name, the write model RoleCreate rejects it, and the toast "Fehler beim Erstellen der Rolle." [error creating the role] appears.
  4. Given a name that another role already uses, when the admin saves, then the unique index on the name refuses it and the same toast "Fehler beim Erstellen der Rolle." appears. There is no separate message for a duplicate name. (no test)
  5. Given valid data, when the admin clicks "Rolle speichern" [save role], then the role is stored, the list reloads, the dialog closes and the toast "Rolle '<name>' wurde erstellt." [role created] appears.
  6. Given text in "Rollen suchen" [search roles], when the table renders, then it shows only the roles whose name or description contains the text, ignoring case.
  7. Given the role form, when the admin types, then the browser stops at 255 characters for the name and at 3 characters for the abbreviation.

Evidence ​

  • app/pages/roles.py: create_roles_page
  • state/role_states.py: RoleState.load_roles, RoleState.create_role, RoleState.open_add_modal, RoleState.close_add_modal, RoleState.set_search_filter, RoleState.filtered_roles
  • components/role.py: roles_table, add_role_modal, role_form_fields, roles_toolbar
  • models/role.py: RoleCreate
  • entities/role.py: RoleEntity
  • repositories/role_repository.py: RoleRepository.find_all_paginated
  • Tests: test_roles.py TestRoleStateAsync.test_load_roles_keeps_rows_when_already_loaded, TestRoleCreateModel.test_max_length_name, TestRoleStateAsync.test_create_role_success, TestRoleState.test_filtered_roles_case_insensitive, TestRoleComponents.test_form_inputs_limit_length_in_browser; test_review_fixes_commons.py TestModelValidation.test_blank_role_name_rejected

Open questions ​

  • The plan modal reads the flags "Ramp-Up" and "Ramp-Down" in ProjectPlanState._effective_ramps_for, and a flagged role gets no ramp shape. The effect belongs to PLAN-20 and to the plan distribution on the calculations page, and this page only links to them.
  • The table has no column for the abbreviation, although the form stores it.

ADM-04 Change or delete a role ​

Change or delete a role, unless projects still use it.

As an administrator, I want to rename or remove roles, so that the role list stays current.

Administrator · Maintain master data / Maintain roles · priority 2 · core · v0.2.0

Acceptance criteria ​

  1. Given the edit icon of a role, when the admin clicks it, then the dialog "Rolle bearbeiten" [edit role] opens with the stored values.
  2. Given changed values, when the admin clicks "Rolle aktualisieren" [update role], then the role is saved and the toast "Rolle '<name>' wurde aktualisiert." [role updated] appears. Without a selected role the toast is "Keine Rolle ausgewählt." [no role selected], and a role that was deleted in the meantime gives "Rolle nicht gefunden." [role not found].
  3. Given the delete icon and the dialog "Löschen bestätigen" [confirm delete], when the admin confirms, then the role is deleted and the toast "Rolle wurde gelöscht." [role deleted] appears. An unknown role gives "Rolle nicht gefunden.".
  4. Given a role that a capacity row, a required capacity or a weekly allocation uses, when the admin deletes it, then the database refuses the delete because these foreign keys use ondelete="RESTRICT", and the toast "Rolle wird noch verwendet und kann nicht gelöscht werden." [role is still in use and cannot be deleted] appears. The links between employees and the role and the daily rate of the role are deleted with the role (CASCADE). Employees with this role as key role keep no key role (SET NULL). (no test)

I moved the pricing page ("Tagessätze") out of the Administration menu into the main menu, right below "Angebote". Everyone signed in can now open and read it, and only admins can change it. Format, lint, typecheck and the full test suite (1566 tests) pass. I didn't check it in the browser because the dev server wasn't running, and nothing is committed yet.

**Menu and page**
- The page moved from `/admin/daily-rates` to `/daily-rates`. Its menu entry now sits after "Angebote" ([sidebar.py](app/components/sidebar.py)).
- The pages everyone can see in the menu (offers and pricing) are now listed together in a new `PUBLIC_ROUTES` constant.
- The page no longer requires admin rights to open, and the subtitle no longer says "Administration" ([daily_rates.py](app/pages/daily_rates.py)).

**Who can do what**
- **Everyone signed in can:** load the price lists, switch between saved lists (through a new `open_list` handler), change view options and compare two lists.
- **Only admins can:** edit, save, archive, duplicate, create lists, change rows and use the switch dialog for unsaved changes. These actions are still blocked on the server too ([price_list_state.py](components/alloq-commons/src/alloq_commons/state/price_list_state.py)).
- **What non-admins see:** the sheet is read-only, the settings fields are disabled, the role picker is disabled, and the row buttons, "Zeile hinzufügen" and the edit buttons in the toolbar are hidden ([price_list.py](components/alloq-commons/src/alloq_commons/components/price_list.py)).

**Tests and docs**
- I added tests for readers, for users who are signed out and for the menu order.
- In the access test, I renamed the list of reader handlers from `OFFER_READER_HANDLERS` to `SIGNED_IN_HANDLERS` and added the price list loads to it.
- The two docs that named the old route now use the new one.

One thing to know: elsewhere, admin rights only open the Administration pages. This is now the only page outside that menu where admin rights decide who can edit, which follows what you asked for. I noted this in memory.
